what: 2-6 values of one unit as vertical bars growing from a zero line, each value counted up over its bar and its label under the baseline
use_when: 2-6 values of one kind compared from zero, where the set as a shape is the story (a week of prices, a count per district)
avoid_when: one value (stat), two values only (compare), values over time (trend, sparkline), parts of a whole (share, budget)
rules: "chart": 2-6 values the article states, above zero, one unit, no computed differences; a label is one or two short words that fit under its bar;
